blurb: Guests can store boats in dry stack or wet slips with amenities including Wi-Fi, water, private restrooms, laundry, and courtesy bikes. The Boat Club offers memberships with access to a fleet of boats and captained experiences, reservable via a smartphone app. Rentals include center consoles, pontoons, kayaks, and paddleboards for half or full day use.
extraNote: A 1 month security deposit equal to first month’s rent required for wet slips · Boat club has $500 refundable security deposit · Boat club charges $20 launch fee per reservation plus fuel at market rate · No initiation fees for boat club membership · Weekday boat club reservations 8am-8pm May-Sept, 8am-6pm Oct-Apr · Weekend boat club reservations 8am-1pm year-round, 2-8pm May-Sept, 2-6pm Oct-Apr · Shared boat club members cannot take two boats out at the same time
